status: 2026-10-13: original script based on official README, GitHub API snapshot, and license files; official demo clips catenoid-helicoid + Lorenz attractor; benchmark chart not used as an independent claim; Option-3 Chatterbox flow required; no on-screen credits.
credits_on_screen: Own capture of https://github.com/academa-labs/manimgx. Animation clips are official ManimGX README demos (catenoid-helicoid and Lorenz attractor). No speed benchmark is presented as independently measured. Core code is MIT; native-wheel licensing differs because of bundled components. No on-screen credit captions.
verify_before_render: Official README: Manim CE-compatible Python API, Rust + wgpu core; browser path uses WebGPU. Do not call it a drop-in replacement without independent compatibility tests.
GitHub API snapshot 2026-10-13 14:31 UTC: 1,077 stars, 68 forks; repository pushed today. Stats are a dated snapshot.

License: repository code is MIT. Official third-party notices say FFmpeg is LGPL-2.1-or-later and x264 is GPL-2.0-or-later in every wheel except Pyodide; native wheels as a whole are GPL-3.0-or-later. Preserve that distinction; not legal advice.
README render-speed figures are project-published benchmarks, not independent measurements; omit them from spoken claims. Animation footage is official project demo media.
No on-screen credit captions. Option 3 Chatterbox Michael continuous-flow voice required.

scenes.say: Catch: native wheels include x264, so the whole native wheel is GPL-3.0-or-later. Speed benchmarks are the project's own; core code is MIT.
Would you animate math in Python and render it with Rust? Comment ManimGX.

youtube.description:
ManimGX is an animation engine with a Manim CE-compatible Python API and a Rust + wgpu rendering core; the project also offers a browser path using WebGPU. The clips shown are official repository demos. Licensing detail: core repository code is MIT, while native wheels bundle x264 and are GPL-3.0-or-later as a whole. The repository's speed benchmarks are its own, not an independent test. GitHub snapshot: 1,077 stars on Oct 13, 2026.
